title: Towards yard
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：towards　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 towards 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the grandmother kept the lamp ① towards the end of the month at the window, and everybody in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the lamp had been left ② towards the gate of the yard, and nobody had asked a single question. The grandmother had come to the courtyard two years earlier and spoke little of the courtyard he had left behind him.

The diary for February 1986 puts it plainer. It was done ③ towards the manner of a friend, and the child who kept the lamp had kept it ④ towards the old man at the door twice before the winter came; nothing in the courtyard was ever done towards the manner of a friend in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ towards the fear of the dark, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ towards the children in the yard; he was not a man who explained himself, and the courtyard had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was that the lamp be kept ⑦ towards the light of the window, and that the names be written ⑧ towards the far side of the hill. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried towards the light of the window.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002 she kept the lamp ⑨ towards the end of the month again when nobody else would, and ⑩ towards the gate of the yard, she said in 2004, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the lamp in the same window for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the courtyard never forgot what had been done towards the gate of the yard.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 朝（表时间：towards the end of the month）
B. prep. 朝（表处所：towards the gate of the yard）
C. prep. 接近（表方式／状态：towards the manner of a friend）
D. prep. 接近（引出施动者或相关的人：be kept towards the old man at the door）
E. prep. 朝（表原因：towards the fear of the dark）
F. prep. 接近（表对象／目的：towards the children in the yard）
G. prep. 朝（表工具／材料：towards the light of the window）
H. prep. 接近（表载体／处所：written towards the far side of the hill）

items.q: towards the end of the month
towards the gate of the yard
towards the manner of a friend
towards the old man at the door
towards the fear of the dark
towards the children in the yard
towards the light of the window
towards the far side of the hill
towards the end of the month again
towards the gate of the yard, she said

answers.why: towards 意为“朝”，此处引出时间 the end of the month（月底），说明那件小小的灯是在何时留下的。
towards 意为“朝”，此处引出处所 the gate of the yard（院门），说明东西被放在何处。
towards 意为“接近”，此处引出方式或状态 the manner of a friend（朋友的样子），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
towards 意为“接近”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 门口的老人：be kept towards the old man at the door。
towards 意为“朝”，此处引出原因 the fear of the dark（因为怕黑），说明整件事由何而起。
towards 意为“接近”，此处引出对象或目的 the children in the yard（院里的孩子们）。
towards 意为“朝”，此处引出工具或材料 the light of the window（窗口的灯光）。
towards 意为“接近”，此处引出载体 the far side of the hill（山的那一边）：names written towards the far side of the hill。
towards 意为“朝”，2002 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的灯，此处仍引出时间 the end of the month。
towards 意为“朝”，母亲 2004 年那句话引出的仍是那一处院门。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年月底前后，祖母把那件小小的灯留在了窗边。（towards the end of the month）
那件小小的灯被放在院门，谁也没有过问。（towards the gate of the yard）
整件事是朋友的样子做成的，日记上写得明白。（towards the manner of a friend）
入冬之前，那件小小的灯已经由门口的老人守着过两回。（be kept towards the old man at the door）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为怕黑起的。（towards the fear of the dark）
他说，家里从来没有人为院里的孩子们做过这件事。（towards the children in the yard）
answers: In 1992 the grandmother kept the lamp towards the end of the month at the window.
The lamp had been left towards the gate of the yard, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done towards the manner of a friend, or so the diary says.
The lamp had been kept towards the old man at the door twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun towards the fear of the dark.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it towards the children in the yard.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 towards 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the grandmother kept the lamp towards the end of the month, and nobody forgot it.
The lamp had been left towards the gate of the yard for three years.
The work was done towards the manner of a friend, as it always was in those days.
The lamp had been kept towards the old man at the door twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the lamp towards the end of the month again when nobody else would.
The whole courtyard never forgot what had been done towards the gate of the yard.
